chunks: Surely the inmates of Paradise will be engaged in pastimes.
ai.seo_question: What are the people of Paradise doing according to Surah Yaseen?
ai.summary: In Shia exegesis, this verse (36:55) is often interpreted to mean that the inhabitants of Paradise are occupied with the joy of beholding Allah and the pleasures of the hereafter, distinct from the labor of worldly life. The term 'fakihun' (joyful/delighted) emphasizes a state of spiritual and physical bliss where they are fully engaged in divine satisfaction. This highlights the contrast between the toil of dunya and the effortless, joyful existence of the akhirah.
